$description: Per-skill triggering eval set for Web Design Studio. Each query is labelled for one named skill; should_trigger applies only to that skill. Use an LLM judge against its frontmatter description to assess routing accuracy. Near-miss negatives include requests that belong to a sibling skill. Deterministic validation checks shape, not accuracy.
